description: PORTLAND, OR – East County Rising, the grassroots organizing powerhouse of East Multnomah County, today announced its endorsement of Governor Tina Kotek for a second term as Governor. “When it comes to protecting the rights and livelihoods of our working families, one thing is clear: Governor Kotek doesn’t mess around,” said East County Rising Founder, Eddy Morales. […]

title: East County Rising Endorses Governor Tina Kotek for Reelection - Tina for Oregon
